pairs.question: Unde ergo nascuntur mei errores?
pairs.answer: Nempe ex hoc uno quòd, cùm latius pateat voluntas quàm intellectus, illam non intra eosdem limites contineo, sed etiam ad illa quae non intelligo extendo; ad quae cùm sit indifferens, facile a vero & bono deflectit, atque ita & fallor & pecco.
pairs.derivation: Author poses the question 'whence do my errors arise?' and answers it himself. The answer begins at 'Nempe' (the operative reply) and runs to the first full stop at 'pecco.'; the whole sentence is retained because it states the cause (will exceeding intellect) and is one continuous explanation with no digression. Stripped section marker '9.'. Nothing precedes 'Unde'/follows 'pecco.' that belongs to the pair.
